QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_6

question.text: Under PMLA, the Adjudicating Authority must serve a notice of not less than how many days on a person suspected of money laundering?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Adjudicating Authority under PMLA may serve a notice of not less than 30 days calling on the person to show cause (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.160). The Trap: 45 and 60 days exceed, and 15 days falls below, the not-less-than-30-days floor stated on p.160. Note: Anchor on the source-backed 30-day minimum show-cause notice from p.160 rather than reasoning from response-preparation time.
